answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A karst of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ferrous of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
